resources.string: Restricted categories, and a PIN to show them
Restricted categories have a lock. To restrict a category, open its options (hold OK).
Hide restricted channels from Recently watched
Hide restricted movies and series from Continue watching
Hide restricted channels, programmes, movies and series from search
While this is on, MyTVPlayer does not keep what you watch in restricted categories.
No PIN is set: restricted categories show without one.
Restricted categories stay hidden until the PIN is entered, and are hidden again when you leave the app.
The PINs are different. Choose a PIN again.
Hide it until the PIN is entered (Settings › Parental controls)
